description: This file declares functions and constants for managing neighboring access point (AP) scanning, including setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, default values, and validation of period ranges.

methods.name: SetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for neighboring AP scans, returning 0 on success and 1 on failure.

methods.name: GetNAPHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for neighboring AP scans in seconds.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for neighboring AP scans in seconds.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: SetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling period for neighboring AP scans.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout after which NAP intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetNAPOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout for accelerated NAP scans in seconds.

methods.name: GetNAPOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated NAP scans.

methods.name: ValidateNAPPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value is within the acceptable range.
